verdict.rationale: Marlin's own documentation shows that once a research topic is set, it runs autonomously for up to roughly eight hours without further human input and can be cancelled mid-execution. That is a single, user-initiated, long-running autonomous job, not a configurable automation. Nothing documents recurring schedules, event triggers, or reusable automation setups, and a one-off run cannot stand in for a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs, trigger-based automations, reusable automation configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of background execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
